name: Rezicraft – Professional Resume & CV Builder
author: ashiquzzaman

sections.description:
Rezicraft is the ultimate WordPress resume and CV builder designed specifically for the modern Gutenberg block editor. Whether you are a software engineer, freelance consultant, digital marketer, or recent graduate, Rezicraft transforms your WordPress site into a powerful, distraction-free career hub.

Stop wrestling with clunky Word document formatting, rigid PDF templates, or expensive third-party SaaS resume builders that lock your personal data behind recurring monthly subscriptions. With Rezicraft, your resume lives securely on your own domain as a native custom post type, giving you absolute control over your professional brand, design styling, and public web presence.

Designed for Recruiters, Built for ATS: Rezicraft features professionally styled, clean-layout templates meticulously structured to meet modern HR hiring standards. Automated Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) reject complex, image-heavy, or multi-column table designs. Rezicraft utilizes semantic, text-forward HTML hierarchies, clean content formatting, and logical section flows that ensure your career history, core competencies, and technical skills are accurately parsed and indexed by corporate screening software every single time.

Why Choose a WordPress-Based Resume Builder?

  • Own Your Career Data: Keep your entire resume history, project lists, and professional milestones on your own server. No third-party data collection, proprietary editor lock-in, or sudden subscription price hikes.
  • Instant Public URLs & Portfolios: Publish your resume with a single click to generate a clean, professional link (e.g., yoursite.com/resume/johndoe) ready to send directly to hiring managers, recruiters, or freelance clients.
  • Native Gutenberg Experience: Edit your experience history, skills matrices, education timelines, and contact details using the familiar WordPress block editor canvas. No complex external page builders required.
  • 100% ATS-Friendly Code Structure: Built with clean semantic HTML markup and structured headings designed to be easily read, parsed, and indexed by automated Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) used by enterprise recruiters.
  • Seamless Theme Integration: Published resumes utilize a dedicated, distraction-free front-end layout designed to look pristine across desktop computers, tablets, and mobile devices, independent of your active theme’s styling quirks.

How It Works

  1. Browse Templates: Open Rezicraft → Templates in your WordPress dashboard to preview professional layouts and visual appearance filters.
  2. Apply Structured Layout: Choose a template pre-filled with clean, professional sample content designed to highlight career progression.
  3. Edit via Gutenberg: Replace sections, headings, skills lists, and achievements using the native block editor canvas.
  4. Publish & Share: Hit publish to immediately launch your live, shareable public resume URL and link it directly from your professional portfolio site.

Designed for Every Professional Workflow

  • For Job Seekers: Publish a standalone online resume page to showcase interactive career timelines, certifications, and portfolio links to hiring managers.
  • For Freelancers & Consultants: Maintain an always-up-to-date Curriculum Vitae right alongside your service offerings and case studies to convert prospective clients.
  • For Agencies & Developers: Rapidly spin up clean, branded client resume pages or executive team bio pages on WordPress without writing custom theme templates.
  • For Personal Brands: Consolidate your professional identity, blog, and career history onto a single domain for a cohesive, authoritative digital footprint.

Comprehensive Resume Sections & Blocks

Build every part of your professional story with dedicated, flexible block structures vetted by HR standards for any career path:

  • Introduction & Summary: Hook recruiters instantly with a compelling professional overview.
  • Experience & History: Chronological work history tracking roles, achievements, and responsibilities.
  • Core Competencies & Strengths: Highlight overarching professional capabilities at a glance.
  • Tools & Technology: Showcase technical stacks, software proficiencies, and hardware familiarity.
  • Projects & Portfolio: Detail key initiatives, open-source contributions, or case studies.
  • Education & Relevant Coursework: Academic credentials tailored for both veterans and recent graduates.
  • Certifications & Licenses: Display industry credentials and professional validations.
  • Volunteering & Leadership Activities: Highlight community involvement and team management experience.
  • Courses & Continuous Learning: Track ongoing professional development and specialized training.
  • Interests, Passions & Hobbies: Add personal depth and cultural fit indicators to your profile.
  • Achievements & Awards: Showcase major milestones and recognition.

Why Professionals Choose Rezicraft

  • Never Send an Outdated PDF Again: Give hiring managers an always-current, lightning-fast live link that opens instantly on mobile or desktop, ensuring they never look at an expired attachment.
  • Target Multiple Job Tracks Instantly: Maintain distinct, tailored resumes for product, marketing, or engineering roles on a single WordPress site, each with its own dedicated, clean URL.
  • Pitch Faster Straight From Your Dashboard: Send polished outreach emails with your live resume link built right in, stopping the endless tab-switching between Gmail, Google Drive, and WordPress.
  • Zero Bloat & Lightning-Fast Loads: Edit naturally inside the native WordPress block editor without wrestling with Elementor columns, mobile breakpoints, or sluggish page builders.
  • Preview Exact Layouts Before Publishing: Eliminate guesswork with live filters and real-time template switching, letting you verify how your professional narrative looks before creating a single draft.
  • Own Your Career Data Forever: Keep 100% control of your professional history on your own domain with zero monthly SaaS fees, zero platform export drama, and total data privacy.

Free vs. Rezicraft Pro Features

Free Version Features:
* General resume template with full Gutenberg block editing support.
* Shareable public resume URL generation.
* Unlimited resume creation using the General template.
* Blank color palette baseline support.
* Responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile layout styling.

Rezicraft Pro Features:
* 16+ ATS-Friendly Templates: Access a wide variety of specialized layouts optimized for different industries and career levels.
* Advanced Color Palettes: Unlock 10+ professional color filters to match your personal brand or website theme.
* Professional Headshots & Mugshots: Easily upload, crop, and manage your profile photo within the resume header.
* Custom Backgrounds: Tailor background styling, colors, and visual container shapes.
* PDF Download Button: Allow recruiters and hiring managers to download a clean, static PDF copy of your CV instantly.
* Print-Ready Optimization: Print stylesheets optimized for high-quality physical printing during in-person interviews.
* Direct Emailing to Recruiters: Enable visitors to send your resume directly to hiring managers via a native OS email modal.
sections.installation:
Quick WordPress Installation

  1. In your WordPress admin dashboard, navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Rezicraft – Professional Resume & CV Builder.
  3. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  4. Open the new Rezicraft menu item in your admin sidebar to browse templates and build your first resume.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin archive and upload the rezicraft-professional-resume-cv-builder folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory on your server.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins management screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Rezicraft → Templates to begin creating your resume.
sections.faq:
Who is Rezicraft built for?

Rezicraft is built for anyone who wants a professional, high-performance resume hosted on their own WordPress site—including job seekers, remote freelancers, independent consultants, educators, and agency developers building profiles for clients.

Where is my resume data stored?

Every resume you create is saved securely in your WordPress database as a native rezicraft_resume custom post type entry. You edit text and blocks just like any standard WordPress post or page.

Can I keep my resume private or password-protected?

Yes. Because resumes are standard custom post types, you can leverage native WordPress visibility settings—such as Password Protected or Private—if you only want specific people to view your CV.

Are resumes built with Rezicraft ATS-friendly?

Yes. Rezicraft avoids complex image-based layouts or nested tables that break automated software, utilizing clean semantic markup structured specifically for Applicant Tracking Systems.

Does Rezicraft require a page builder like Elementor or Divi?

No. Rezicraft is built natively for the WordPress Gutenberg block editor. It provides a smooth WYSIWYG editing experience straight out of the box without bloating your site with heavy third-party page builder assets.

Can recruiters download my resume as a PDF?

PDF download functionality, along with direct recruiter emailing and advanced color palettes, is available in Rezicraft Pro.

Can I prevent search engines from indexing my resume?

Yes. You can use the default WordPress settings to discourage search engines from indexing your site so that your resumes don’t appear in public search results. You can also password-protect your resumes.
